entries.title: Isaiah 35:1
segments: ¶The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.

entries.title: Isaiah 35:2
segments: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the LORD, [and] the excellency of our God.

entries.title: Isaiah 35:3
segments: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.

entries.title: Isaiah 35:4
segments: Say to them [that are] of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come [with] vengeance, [even] God [with] a recompence; he will come and save you. {fearful: Heb. hasty}

words.text: to them [that are] of a fearful

entries.title: Isaiah 35:5
segments: ¶Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.

entries.title: Isaiah 35:6
segments: Then shall the lame [man] leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.

entries.title: Isaiah 35:7
segments: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, [shall be] grass with reeds and rushes. {grass...: or, a court for reeds, etc}

words.text: . {grass...: or, a court for reeds, etc}

entries.title: Isaiah 35:8
segments: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it [shall be] for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err [therein]. {but...: or, for he shall be with them}

entries.title: Isaiah 35:9
segments: No lion shall be there, nor [any] ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk [there]:

words.text: thereon, it shall not be found

entries.title: Isaiah 35:10
segments: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
